title: Leveraging Classical and Quantum Computing for Process Systems Engineering Applications: Decomposition Algorithm with Ising Solvers for Efficient Discrete Landscape Exploration
summary: Conceptual process design is a crucial aspect of chemical engineering that involves process synthesis. Mixed-integer nonlinear programming is a powerful framework for modeling such design problems by combining discrete and continuous variables; however, the combinatorial complexity of discrete choices, coupled with nonlinearities, presents challenging monolithic problems. Using decomposition, discrete subproblems can potentially benefit from Ising solvers, while simulators and nonlinear solvers offer powerful tools for handling nonlinearities.
